name: Elshe no Shounen
source:
Rio, a boy who lives in a certain kingdom, has been imprisoned by Elche for nine years since he was confined.

Rio has been told many times that "the outside world is dangerous", but due to the constant boredom of everyday life, he gradually began to have a longing for the outside world.

However, what was waiting for Rio in the outside world was a shocking fact that far exceeded his expectations.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23729]Freem![/url]]
translation:
生活在某个王国的少年里奥，被艾尔谢囚禁至今，已经过去了九年。

尽管对方反复告诉他“外面的世界很危险”，日复一日的无聊生活还是让他渐渐对外界产生了向往。

然而，外面的世界等待着里奥的，却是远远超出他想象的惊人真相。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23729]Freem![/url]]
